resources.string: Your personal local data vault for repetitive text snippets. No more typing the same addresses or IDs over and over.
QuickFill stores everything locally in your device. No cloud syncing, no trackers. Your data stays yours.
If suggestions do not appear automatically, long press the field, tap Autofill, then choose a saved snippet.
To use QuickFill, you need to enable it as your Autofill provider in Android Settings.
QuickFill is no longer selected as your Autofill service. Turn it back on in Android Settings to keep using your saved snippets.
Android may show a standard trust warning before you can select QuickFill again.
Open any app with a text field.
Long press the text field to open the edit menu.
Pick a QuickFill snippet for that app.
